resources.string: Check and download missing OBB files
Exiting cancels checks and downloads and removes temporary downloads. Saved OBB files are kept. Saves already started in the game will finish.

Enable the HET module and start the game, then check OBB files. HET uses the matching release (for example, v5.19.0 for game version 5.19.0) and downloads missing files only. Existing files are neither overwritten nor checked.\n\nDownloads may use substantial data. Keep this window open. Closing it cancels checks and downloads; saves already started in the game will finish.
